name: commitKeyDamageHeal
covers: heal: the commit key is damaged silently while a device holds the pre-damage base; the device's commit lands over the damage first and the recovery exit abandons

labels.H: read commit key (base); H: upload uni: h: open, commit: the read of the commit key (the base it holds), the eleven unit uploads
labels.ENV: commit key DAMAGED (silent: the rev: environment step damage-commit, after h's read and before h's commit-key write
labels.H: commit CAS at the base version ok (he: h: the commit-key write, held until x has read the damaged key; on Node the damaged key has the revision h holds
labels.X: recovery exit over the damaged key: x: waits for the damage, then opens (its boot read is the damaged key) and runs the exit on that read: its fence write, then its marker write at the damaged key's version, held until h's write is applied
labels.X: marker CAS conflicts; the key parses: x: exit:abandoned, nothing of the marker landed
